# Motion blur

Blurs moving objects and camera motion along their path, as a camera shutter does. Reads the velocity buffer, which the composer renders only while an effect needs it.

<EffectDemo effect="motion-blur" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { motionBlur } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/motion-blur';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(motionBlur({ preset: 'film' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 1`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type    | Default | Range       | Description                                                                                                                      |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity` | number  | `1`     | 0 – 3       | Shutter length as a fraction of the frame time: 1 blurs over one frame of motion (a 360° shutter), 0.5 is the classic film look. |
| `samples`   | integer | `12`    | 2 – 32      | Samples along the motion; more are smoother.                                                                                     |
| `maxBlur`   | number  | `0.05`  | 0.005 – 0.2 | Longest blur as a fraction of the frame, so very fast motion stays readable.                                                     |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                      |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `film`    | `intensity: 0.5`                              |
| `fast`    | `intensity: 2`, `samples: 24`, `maxBlur: 0.1` |
| `subtle`  | `intensity: 0.3`, `samples: 8`                |
| `streaky` | `intensity: 3`, `samples: 32`, `maxBlur: 0.2` |

Apply one with `motionBlur({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Geometry buffers:** reads , which the composer renders only while an effect needs them.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 63.8 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Quality tiers:** low: `samples: 5`; medium: `samples: 8`; high keeps the effect's own values. Set `quality`, or leave it `auto` for an [adaptive composer](/guide/performance).
- **Size:** 6.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/motion-blur`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: McGuire et al., A Reconstruction Filter for Plausible Motion Blur, I3D 2012 (centered velocity sampling and background weighting, simplified).

## Related

- [Directional blur](./directional-blur) — Smears the image along one direction, like a fast camera pan or a streak of speed.
- [Radial & zoom blur](./radial-blur) — Blurs toward or around a center point: a zoom burst that rushes at the viewer, or a spin like a rotating camera.
- [Depth of field](./depth-of-field) — Blurs what is nearer or farther than the focus distance, as a wide-aperture lens does.
